text.card: A red giant 2,538 parsecs away, 14 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 5, give 0.87 solar masses and 14.2 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,430 K at its surface.
